views.view_definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.barbershop_id,
    c.name,
    c.phone,
    a.total_visits,
    a.total_spent,
    a.last_visit
   FROM (customers c
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::text AS total_visits,
            (COALESCE(sum(v.total_amount), (0)::numeric))::text AS total_spent,
            max(v.visited_at) AS last_visit
           FROM visits v
          WHERE ((v.barbershop_id = c.barbershop_id) AND (v.customer_id = c.id) AND (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))) a);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.owned_barbershop_ids()
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select membership.barbershop_id
  from public.barbershop_users as membership
  where membership.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and (select auth.uid()) is not null
    and membership.role = 'OWNER';
$function$
